title: Noah's Flood and the Destruction of Sodom
description: Peter highlights God's judgment on the old world through the flood and over Sodom and Gomorrah, while emphasizing God's ability to rescue the righteous like Noah and Lot. These stories serve as a warning against ungodliness and as proof that the Lord knows how to deliver the godly from trials, while keeping the unrighteous reserved for the day of judgment.
